ai.title: Add Mermaid diagram support to docs
ai.summary: Docs components now render Mermaid diagrams via new `mermaid-diagram.tsx` and updated `code-demo.tsx` logic. This enables visual flowcharts and sequence diagrams within agent customization documentation. Scope includes `web/src/components/docs/mdx/` and related content files. Mermaid library added to `web/package.json` dependencies.

eli5.text: The documentation for customizing agents now lets writers embed live flowcharts and sequence diagrams directly inside the pages you read, instead of showing the raw diagram text as plain code. When someone marks a code block as a "mermaid" diagram, the page now draws it as a picture right there; behind the scenes the site pulled in a new diagram-drawing library and taught the existing code-block component to hand those blocks off to a dedicated diagram component. If you browse the agent-customization guides today, you'll see diagrams render as graphics rather than as indented text, and the sidebar that lists all the docs lost its Project Showcase section while a couple of mobile layout tweaks were made so things don't get cut off on narrow screens.

ai.title: Fix agent template schema rendering in docs
ai.summary: AgentTemplateSchemaDisplay and AgentOverrideSchemaDisplay now import their dedicated components instead of aliasing to generic SchemaDisplay. The redundant dynamic imports in the docs page were removed. This ensures agent templates render correctly in the MDX pipeline.

eli5.text: If you looked at the documentation pages that show agent template settings, those pages will now display the templates correctly instead of showing a generic, unreadable layout. The documentation system was previously pointing two template-display sections to a shared, generic template, which caused the formatting to break; now each section uses its own dedicated template. This fix is live today in the documentation site.
